comment: JP2 0010: Suter's foreword, second page (p. VI): thanks to Andersen, Billeter and the late Pechüle; the hope of the editor; place, date and signature.

observations: The page number «VI» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.

Spaced type: the names «Andersen» (L01), «Billeter» (L02) and «Pechüle» (L04); «Athelhard’sche» (L12) is not spaced. L07: «Nachtrag 1)» refers to the first of the editor's additions (pp. 233–237), the figure and the bracket in the type of the text, not raised. L15: the signature «H. Suter.» in italics at the right, a little below the line of the place and date (L14).
